name: Skillporter
tagline: Audit, scan and sync AI agent skills across 19 harnesses.
description: Read-only MCP server for workspace-level agent-skill hygiene. Exposes nine tools: `skillporter_diagnose` (broken symlinks, SHA-256 content drift between harness copies, duplicate loading), `skillporter_detect` (which harnesses are active), `skillporter_scan` (static supply-chain scan: embedded secrets, prompt-injection overrides, hidden Unicode, curl-pipe-shell, reverse shells, symlink escapes), `skillporter_inspect`, and `skillporter_matrix` (the 19-harness compatibility matrix). Write tools (`add`, `install`, `sync`, `remove`) are listed but return an error unless the server is started with `--allow-writes`. Tool arguments are treated as untrusted and confined to the workspace root. Speaks JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio, MCP protocol version 2024-11-05. Python 3.9+, zero runtime dependencies, MIT.
